LLM-Agent (KG Generation and Reasoning Using RD-FLib)A key feature of the proposed framework is the use of the LLM-Agent for KG Generation and Reasoning (Step 6). Using RDFLib reasoning tools, this component adds new knowledge to the Knowledge Graph and performs reasoning to support subsequent answers. The system can enrich its existing knowledge with new relational data and enhance reasoning capabilities, ensuring that it adapts to user interactions over time.
